verdict.rationale: Rule backtesting is a fair question for a fraud-prevention platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only order-decision APIs (decide/submit/advise), notifications, chargeback handling, and Riskified-team model calibration during onboarding. None of it shows an analyst-facing way to replay a rule against historical traffic and see what it would have blocked, flagged, or cost.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, I can backtest a rule against my historical traffic before deploying it, seeing exactly what it would have blocked, flagged, and cost
